method: Actual inspection of the atlas for both selected events, both covering order cutouts, native profiles and one systematic fixed central +/-8-column, full31-row enlargement for both orders. Original counts and positive excess both inspected. No coordinate, method, selection or classifier threshold changed.
independence: No secondary review or root-adopted labels read before saving this review. Primary reviewer also prepared and ran extraction; this is not an independent numerical audit.
limitations: Post-detection AI visual judgments, not blinded scientific validation, human review or physical-origin proof.
A is provisional charge morphology for the selected component; additional underlying photon flux is not excluded.
Fixed side-background subtraction and nearby calibration-fiber signal limit interpretation of weak components.
No qualified laser candidate, calibrated null, global false-alarm rate or sensitivity claim follows.

events.evidence: Order64 has a thin, gently sloping charge-like trail spanning columns about -8 to 0 and crossing the predicted central row/trace. The sharp native spike coincides with this localized track. The full-cutout scale is dominated by a separate bright adjacent trace; fixed central enlargement reveals the selected morphology.

Order66 shows a compact bright off-center deposit around column -2,row +1 with a thin diagonal tail extending through the central trace near row0. Its geometry is charge-like and accompanies the narrow native enhancement. The far-right bright adjacent trace dominates the full atlas scale and is distinct from this central contaminant.
